rows.name: NHTSA vPIC
rows.licenseNote: U.S. government public dataset. This snapshot stores passenger car, truck, and multipurpose passenger vehicle model names only. No VINs and no premium figures.
rows.accessMethod: HTTPS GET of the vPIC model list, saved as a versioned catalog snapshot.
rows.refreshCadence: Rebuild when the catalog refresh date arrives. The current snapshot asks for a refresh after 20 March 2027.

rows.name: FuelEconomy.gov vehicles.csv
rows.owner: U.S. Department of Energy and U.S. Environmental Protection Agency
rows.licenseNote: U.S. government public dataset. This snapshot keeps year, make, base model, and model name. Fuel-cost and economy figures are not stored.
rows.accessMethod: HTTPS download of vehicles.csv, described at https://www.fueleconomy.gov/feg/ws/index.shtml.
rows.refreshCadence: Rebuild with the NHTSA snapshot. The current snapshot asks for a refresh after 20 March 2027.

rows.name: BLS CPI, motor vehicle insurance
rows.licenseNote: BLS publications are in the public domain, except previously copyrighted images. Do not use the BLS emblem. We record the 2023 average and the latest monthly value next to the state baselines as optional price-trend inputs. The series is not applied to any figure.
rows.accessMethod: Public series CUUR0000SETE, fetched through the BLS public API on 22 September 2026.
rows.refreshCadence: Refresh the recorded values when the state baselines are refreshed.

rows.name: State statutes and insurance departments
rows.licenseNote: Public statute and government pages. Every state and DC has a row with at least one source link and a check date. A figure we couldn't confirm stays blank. This is a table of legal minimums, not a premium.
rows.accessMethod: Pages read directly or in a browser and cited on each state row, with short quotes in data/state-rules/evidence.json. No bulk download.
rows.refreshCadence: Re-check a row when its law changes. Scheduled changes are listed on the row, and a test fails once one takes effect.

rows.name: NAIC publications catalog
rows.licenseNote: A link to NAIC's publications list, so you can look for newer editions. No publication text is stored.
rows.refreshCadence: Check the catalog when a new auto database publication is announced. Do not download files into this bundle.

rows.name: 2023 Auto Insurance Database Average Premium Supplement
rows.licenseNote: Not used. This June 2025 supplement had preliminary 2023 figures. The December 2025 report revised many of them, so we use the report instead. No figures from this edition are stored.
rows.accessMethod: Citation link only. The PDF is not stored in this repository.
rows.refreshCadence: None. Superseded by the December 2025 report.

rows.name: 2022/2023 Auto Insurance Database Report
rows.licenseNote: Used with credit. The owner approved using the per-state 2023 figures as facts, for non-commercial use. We store three per-state numbers from the 2023 column (combined average premium, liability average premium, and average expenditure) and credit them as: Source: NAIC, 2022/2023 Auto Insurance Database Report, 2023 data. We don't copy the report's text or tables, and the PDF is not in this repository.
rows.accessMethod: Read in a browser (the NAIC site blocks scripts). Figures transcribed from Tables 5, 1C, and 4 and checked twice against the PDF text. The PDF is not stored here.
rows.refreshCadence: Check for a newer edition about once a year. A new edition means a new data/state-baselines version.
derivedFields: typical yearly premium by state (2023 combined average premium, Table 5)
liability average premium by state (2023, Table 1C)

rows.name: SERFF and state filing portals
rows.owner: National Association of Insurance Commissioners, for SERFF. State departments, for filing portals.
rows.licenseNote: Not used. No filing data is included. Not cleared for a factor.
rows.refreshCadence: None. This bundle does not refresh filing data.

rows.name: IIHS/HLDI insurance losses by make and model
rows.owner: Insurance Institute for Highway Safety and Highway Loss Data Institute
rows.licenseNote: Citation link only. Loss tables are not copied. Not cleared for a vehicle factor.
rows.accessMethod: Link only. No table is downloaded.
rows.refreshCadence: None. This bundle does not refresh loss tables.

rows.name: NotAQuote factor bundle
rows.licenseNote: Original planning factors. Not a rate filing and not computed from a premium, expenditure, exposure, or loss figure.
rows.accessMethod: Committed with the app as model-factors.json and run in the browser.
rows.refreshCadence: A factor change ships as a new bundle version and a changelog row.
